title: Roll the vuoro-cloud tenant runtime from vuoro-service 0.1.94 to 0.1.104

blockers.description: config/compatibility.json still pins vuoro-service-v0.1.94 with release_ready false; pyproject.toml lists both the vuoro-service 0.1.100 and 0.1.104 wheel URLs (separate extras). The pin change and its compatibility evidence are source work that must land first. 0.1.102 and later need work schema 30 and 0.1.103 needs Work31, so the tenant work-schema mapping must be known; its contract is merged as proposed in vuoro#312 but not implemented.
blockers.resolved_by: source PR in vuoro-cloud bumping config/compatibility.json and apps/runtime-config/compatibility.json, plus the vuoro source PR implementing the tenant schema-version mapping contract (vuoro#312, acceptance criteria 1-5)

blockers.description: The rollout ships through a promotion.

why_operator: Moving the tenant runtime is a deployment change through the signed promotion path, and the runtime pin lives in a SOPS-encrypted Secret that only the operator's age key can verify.

preconditions.command: git fetch origin && git show origin/main:config/compatibility.json | grep -n 'vuoro-service\|release_ready'
preconditions.expected: vuoro-service-v0.1.104@sha256:<digest> and release_ready true after the source PR lands

preconditions.check: Published 0.1.104 wheel digest matches the attested release
preconditions.observed: pyproject.toml line 39 pins vuoro-service-v0.1.104 with sha256=39f5ee32...c8e4 (equal to the attested wheel); line 35 also pins 0.1.100

commands.expected: compatibility.json, its runtime-config mirror and the decrypted Secret agree on the 0.1.104 image; non-zero exit means not verified

commands.command: Run package vuoro-cloud-poc-promotion for the head that carries the pin change

commands.expected: running tenant-runtime pin reported as the 0.1.104 digest (or unknown with a reason); held tenants unchanged; gate none or the next named gate

expected_result: Pilot tenant runtime serving vuoro-service 0.1.104 with the declared and deployed pins equal; four held tenants untouched.
send_back: verify-runtime-pin output (pass or the exact mismatch)

rollback.description: Promote a new higher generation pinning the previous runtime digest; the expanded schema stays (forward-only migrations).
commands: Run package vuoro-cloud-poc-promotion with the previous accepted digest
